figurative_meaning_en: Immature; childish or underdeveloped in mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি এখনও ছেলেমানুষ, বড় হয়ে উঠো।
example_sentences_in_english: You're still so childish, grow up.
Stop acting childish; it won't get the job done.
note: This idiom is widely used in spoken Bengali to gently criticize immature behavior without harshness.
